Elon Musk on Terafab's vision for the future of AI chips:

"We're building something that, to the best of my knowledge, doesn't exist anywhere in the world."

Key highlights:

• A single facility will design lithography masks, manufacture chips, package them, and test them—all under one roof.
• Engineers will be able to rapidly iterate: design a chip, test it, improve it, and repeat the process in one building.
• The factory will produce both logic and memory chips while dramatically accelerating development cycles.
• Musk says Terafab won't be limited to conventional computing—it will also explore entirely new computing architectures and push the limits of physics.
• He believes this rapid design-to-test feedback loop could make chip development an order of magnitude faster than anywhere else in the world.

For Musk, speed of iteration is the ultimate competitive advantage.

BREAKING: Redwire's SpaceMD has announced its first commercial mission aboard SpaceX's Starfall spacecraft. 

The mission aims to accelerate pharmaceutical development and microgravity manufacturing in space.

• Launch planned for 2028.
• SpaceMD will fly 32 PIL-BOXes—the largest dedicated commercial microgravity research mission ever flown.
• The mission will support pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and other in-space manufacturing research.

"Space-based pharmaceutical development is reaching an inflection point," said SpaceMD CEO John Vellinger, highlighting the combination of Redwire's flight-proven microgravity payloads with SpaceX's transportation capabilities to expand research capacity and accelerate the development of life-changing therapies.

Terafab just got real.

Tesla and SpaceX officially confirmed today that the full-scale Terafab will be built in Grimes County, Texas (near College Station / Houston area).

Key stats from the announcement:
•  Initial investment: $16.8 billion
•  Planned size: over 100 million square feet — Elon called it “the largest and most valuable building on Earth by far”
•  Goal: produce over 1 terawatt of AI compute per year
•  Jobs: at least 3,000 (mostly local hires)
•  Vertically integrated: logic, memory, advanced packaging, and testing all under one roof
This is the massive chip factory designed to supply the extreme volumes Tesla and SpaceX will need for Optimus, Cybercabs, and space-based AI data centers — far beyond what the entire global semiconductor industry can currently deliver.
They already broke ground on the smaller research fab at Giga Texas earlier this year. Now the real one is locked in.
The future is being built in Texas.




Elon Musk (@elonmusk)

Terafab Texas will be the largest and most valuable building on Earth by far.

And it will be stunningly beautiful.

If you live in Delaware, Leave


Leave Delaware (@LeaveDelaware)

🚨JUST IN: Granite Ridge Resources Inc
(NYSE: GRNT) officially leaves Delaware.

Another day.  Another NYSE-listed company formally leaves Delaware for Texas.

Granite Ridge Resources’ new SEC filing states that on August 5, the company changed its state of incorporation from Delaware to Texas following shareholder approval.

• Delaware corporate law no longer governs the company
• The Texas Business Organizations Code now governs it
• Its Delaware charter and bylaws were replaced with Texas governing documents
• Its shares continue trading on the NYSE under the same ticker

One completed conversion at a time, the automatic Delaware default is disappearing.

The TeraFab Scale
To reach a terawatt of AI compute output per year, SpaceX needs a chip factory at a scale that does not exist.

That is the TeraFab.

Elon Musk on the size:

~ 100 million square feet of factory floor
~ 10x larger than the entire Tesla Gigafactory Texas
~ Designed to produce one billion full-reticle chip equivalents per year
~ Each chip producing roughly one kilowatt of compute

For context, current global AI chip manufacturing tops out at around 100 gigawatts per year of total compute.

The TeraFab is built for 1000 gigawatts.

That is 10 times the current global capacity, from a single facility.
